task: Enlarge a small photo four times and save it as a PNG
packaging_note: Uses the upstream RealESRGANer, full precision and tiled CPU inference with the x4plus model.

outputs.what: a PNG four times the width and height

known_issues: Runs on CPU. Large pictures take longer; the model estimates detail rather than recovering the original scene.
licence: BSD-3-Clause (source); upstream has not confirmed redistribution terms for the x4plus weights. The image does not contain them.

access.why: Downloads the 67 MB x4plus model from the upstream release on first use. The download container cannot see your photo.

x-display.title: Enlarge a photo by 4×
x-display.summary: Make a PNG four times the width and height of your original photo.
x-display.description: Use this when a small photograph needs a larger image for a layout or further editing. The model estimates what extra detail might look like; the larger result should be reviewed alongside the original.
